contribution.assessment: The paper remains a useful synthesis rather than a falsifying physiological test or major empirical advance. It contributes a clean distribution-free null theorem (G_V = 0 for deterministic pooled controllers driven by summed single-site waveforms regardless of common output saturation), an exact algebraic separation of electrical interaction from shared Poiseuille/diameter saturation, and an honest numerical stress test—including a simultaneous-stimulation design (46–129 obs/cond), nearby concentration sign reversal (11.80–11.85 mM), and negative conductance-band slow-resetting sensitivity—built atop published Kir/TRPV4 mechanisms (Moshkforoush et al. 2020; Harraz et al. 2018) and Longden's (2026) paired-capillary proposal, without external paired tissue data to validate model kinetics or coupling.
